sentences: The source considers depth-two circuits for a linear computational task and asks whether arbitrary circuits can be linearized efficiently.
Linearization would replace possibly nonlinear intermediate behavior by a representation using the intended linear operations.
The question tests whether leaving the linear model temporarily can provide substantial savings even when the final output is linear.
Resolving it would help interpret lower bounds proved only for linear circuits.
